verdict.rationale: Postmark offers event-driven hooks: configurable real-time webhooks for delivery, bounce and other events, plus inbound processing with blocking rules, retries and rule bypass. These push events to the user's own endpoint, so any actions must be built and hosted by the user. There is no evidence of a native rule engine that triggers actions inside Postmark. Missing for 10: a first-party rule/condition builder that executes actions automatically, documented event-to-action workflows beyond webhook delivery, and independent hands-on corroboration.
